headword: {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}

definitions.explanation: A company of Japanese origin or with Japanese capital that operates in a foreign country. The term emphasizes the Japanese identity of the company as seen from an overseas perspective.

examples.japanese: {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a Japanese company.

examples.japanese: タイには{多|おお}くの{日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}が{進出|しんしゅつ}している。
examples.english: Many Japanese companies have expanded into Thailand.

examples.japanese: {現地|げんち}の{日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}は{日本語|にほんご}ができる{人材|じんざい}を{求|もと}めている。
examples.english: Local Japanese companies are looking for personnel who can speak Japanese.

notes:
USAGE:
Used when discussing Japanese businesses from the perspective of their overseas operations. Common in business news, job listings, and discussions of international commerce.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}に{就職|しゅうしょく}する (to get a job at a Japanese company abroad)
- {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}の{進出|しんしゅつ} (expansion of Japanese companies overseas)
- {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}{向|む}け (aimed at Japanese companies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外資系|がいしけい}: foreign-affiliated — the reverse perspective, a foreign company operating in Japan
